explanation: The theorem says the 2x2 rotation matrix (!![cos θ, -sin θ; sin θ, cos θ]) is additive in θ, as elements of the orthogonal group. I searched Mathlib for matrices of that shape and for matrix-rotation lemmas. The only hits were PolarCoord (a Jacobian matrix) and a docstring in GeneralLinearGroup/Basic. Mathlib's rotation API (Orientation.rotation, Circle rotations on ℂ) is stated for linear isometries, not for these matrices in orthogonalGroup. Deriving the matrix statement from it would take more than two short lines. I found no matching declaration.
